name: Valdenebro (Spain)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, white at the lower hoist and purple at the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Valdenebro (a tree and a castle on white, a plough on green).
history: Municipal flag of Valdenebro; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Valdenebro arms — tree and castle on white, plough on green
